name: How much does foggy window repair cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does foggy window repair cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of foggy window repair in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on several factors, including the size and type of the window, whether it's an insulated glass unit (IGU) replacement or a defogging service, and the complexity of the installation. Repairing just the sealed unit is generally less expensive than replacing the entire window frame. For an accurate estimate, it's best to schedule a consultation with a local contractor who can assess your specific windows and provide a detailed quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foggy window repair costs in the Bay Area vary by window size, type, repair method (IGU replacement vs. defogging), and installation complexity. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.
